Polymarket Elon Tweet Trader v1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches automated trading for Polymarket "Elon Musk # tweets" markets using real-time XTracker data.
- Implements cluster strategy: buys center and adjacent tweet-count buckets when combined cost < $1 for edge.
- Includes configurables for position sizing, entry/exit prices, bucket spread, and risk controls.
- Provides CLI commands to check stats, manage positions, execute trades, and update config.
- Automatic import of new Polymarket tweet markets when needed.
- All trades tagged and tracked separately for easy monitoring and P&L.
- Built-in safeguards: market health checks, slippage limits, flip-flop protection, and extreme price avoidance.
